obligations.summary: Personal data lawfully collected for other purposes may be processed in the AI regulatory sandbox for developing, training, and testing AI systems only when the AI system is developed for substantial public interest by a public authority or legal person in specified areas.
exceptions: Processing is not permitted unless the AI system targets one of the listed public interest areas: public safety/health, environment/biodiversity, energy sustainability, transport/infrastructure resilience, or public administration efficiency.

obligations.summary: Providers must ensure that personal data processed in the sandbox is necessary for complying with high-risk AI requirements under Chapter III Section 2, and cannot be substituted by anonymised, synthetic, or other non-personal data.

Providers must implement effective monitoring mechanisms to identify high risks to data subjects' rights and freedoms during sandbox experimentation and maintain response mechanisms to promptly mitigate those risks, including stopping processing if necessary.

Providers must ensure that personal data processed in the sandbox is held in a functionally separate, isolated, and protected data processing environment under their control, with access restricted to authorised persons only.
Providers may only share originally collected data in accordance with Union data protection law, and any personal data created within the sandbox must not be shared outside the sandbox.

Providers must ensure that processing of personal data in the sandbox does not lead to measures or decisions affecting data subjects and does not affect the exercise of data subjects' rights under Union data protection law.

Providers must protect personal data processed in the sandbox with appropriate technical and organisational measures and delete it once sandbox participation has terminated or the retention period has ended.
Providers must retain logs of all personal data processing activities in the sandbox for the duration of sandbox participation, unless Union or national law provides otherwise.
exceptions: Retention period may differ if Union or national law specifies otherwise.

obligations.summary: Providers must maintain a complete and detailed description of the process and rationale behind training, testing, and validation of the AI system, together with testing results, as part of the technical documentation under Annex IV.
Providers must publish a short summary of the sandbox AI project, its objectives, and expected results on the competent authorities' website.
exceptions: Sensitive operational data relating to law enforcement, border control, immigration, or asylum authorities is exempt from the publication obligation.

obligations.summary: For processing of personal data in AI regulatory sandboxes by law enforcement authorities for the prevention, investigation, detection, or prosecution of criminal offences, processing must be based on a specific Union or national law and meet all the same cumulative conditions as set out in paragraph 1.
